verdict.rationale: Airweave's docs explicitly provide a self-hosting path via `git clone` + `./start.sh` and state you can 'deploy it locally on macOS, Linux or WSL' if you prefer to run it yourself, confirming the core product is open and self-hostable. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment and documentation of production-grade (non-local) self-hosted deployment (e.g., Docker/K8s for scale).
